name: Negasonic Teenage Warhead

abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Incinerate Vulnerability: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Counter-Attack Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Vuruşları temas etmediği için normal şampiyonlar siperleyemez — Jack O'Lantern, Photon, Angela, Ironheart gibi temassız vuruş siperleyebilenler gerekli. Ayrıca sık sık yere sermek kaçışını kapatır.
signatureAbility:
offensive Predetermination
As an Attacker, Negasonic's Evade Counter-Attack inflicts [0.8 - 3] Incinerates, rounded up, and personal Incinerates are paused during her Special Attacks. Additionally, Striker Hits and Counter-Attacks pause Incinerate and Incinerate Vulnerability as if they were Light Attacks.
As a Defender, start each fight with [40 - 100]% of a Bar of Power.

abilitySections.title: Personal Passives
content: During the fight, Negasonic can inflict the following Passives.
Incinerate: Deals [3,490.55] Energy Damage over 14 seconds. Max Stacks: 40
Incinerate Vulnerability: 50% potency. Lasts 16 seconds and doesn't stack.
Stun: Lasts 2 seconds. If the Parry Mastery is active, it also inflicts a Stun Passive for 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Utilizing bursts of atomic energy, all of Negasonic's attacks deal Energy Damage and do not make contact.
Medium Attacks inflict 1 Incinerate if the Opponent has fewer than 5 personal Incinerates active on them.
Light Attacks pause all currently active personal Incinerates and Incinerate Vulnerability Passives for 1.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Precognition - Evade Counter-Attack
content: Negasonic enters each fight with a Precognition Charge which allows her to Evade an attack and Counter-Attack, inflicting a Stun Passive. This Evade won't activate while Blocking.
15% chance to Evade Medium and Light Attacks that make contact, increased to 100% while charging a Heavy Attack.
100% chance to Evade an Opponent's Counter-Attack.

abilitySections.title: Precognition - Cooldown
content: Each time Evade activates or is prevented from activating, Precognition goes on cooldown for 25 seconds.
Additionally, Precognition goes on cooldown each time Negasonic is knocked down or inflicted with a Power Burn, Power Drain, or Power Lock effect.
Each time the opponent lands a Critical Hit, including through Block, 1.5 seconds is removed from the cooldown.
While fighting Tech Champions, Precognition begins on cooldown.

abilitySections.title: While Fighting Skill Champions
content: The Opponent's Bleed, Evade, and True effects suffer -100% Ability Accuracy. Additionally, Precognition does not go on cooldown from Evading a Counter-Attack.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: This attack can be charged 5 seconds longer than normal.
The first hit inflicts an Incinerate Vulnerability.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The first hit refreshes all personal Incinerates, even if Blocked.
Each hit after the first inflicts 1 Incinerate.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: After the first hit, rapidly pressing Block builds up dormant Incinerates, up to 16, which are inflicted by the final hit.
If Block is pressed 4 or fewer times, the final hit instead inflicts between 4 and 12 Incinerates at random.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflicts 1 Stun and Incinerate Vulnerability as well as 3 Incinerates, all at +50% duration.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - offensive Predetermination
content: As an Attacker, Negasonic's Evade Counter-Attack inflicts [0.8 - 3] Incinerates, rounded up, and personal Incinerates are paused during her Special Attacks. Additionally, Striker Hits and Counter-Attacks pause Incinerate and Incinerate Vulnerability as if they were Light Attacks.
As a Defender, start each fight with [40 - 100]% of a Bar of Power.
